SourceDirectory.description: An addressable local directory referenced by Markdown. It is a resource target, not a document and has no source payload.

id.description: Required snapshot-local record identity; does not require a globally stable authored ID.

SourceDirectory.title: SourceDirectory

SourceDocument.description: A discovered Markdown or related file. A failed read retains identity, locator, status and diagnostics.

id.description: Required snapshot-local record identity; does not require a globally stable authored ID.

payload.description: Present only after successful read; graph rule requires it for read_status=read.

SourceFragment.description: An addressable heading, explicit anchor, or occurrence in a source document, without implying domain-element identity.

id.description: Required snapshot-local record identity; does not require a globally stable authored ID.

SourceLocation.description: A diagnostic source location, including path-only or external-to-snapshot locations without invented coordinates.

SourcePayload.description: Exact original bytes before Goldmark/specfile normalization, including BOM, CRLF, trailing newlines and invalid encodings.

bytes_base64.description: Required for inline_base64 storage; decode and verify digest and byte count.

immutable_locator.description: Required for external storage; bytes must remain retrievable and match the digest.

text_encoding.description: Detected or declared decoding; original bytes remain authoritative.

SourcePayload.title: SourcePayload

SourceReference.description: An authored reference occurrence, independent of whether it resolves or carries semantic intent.

authored_target.description: Literal destination or label, including fragments; do not replace it with a normalized target.

id.description: Required snapshot-local record identity; does not require a globally stable authored ID.

SourceResource.description: An addressable source; only SourceDocument implies locally acquired bytes.

revision.description: Known source revision or base revision.

version_system.description: For example git, a versioned object store or an archive.

working_copy_modified.description: Omit when unknown; payload digest identifies the observed bytes regardless.

owning_system.description: Derived directory ownership, not use-case boundary or requirement inheritance.

preamble.description: Authored content between the title and the first named section.
